answer: Lotus Escrow Quota. Each identity must escrow one real external asset (a walnut-sized compute lease) held for 90 days; the lease is non-transferable and forfeited entirely on any duplicate-behavior flag. A sable-toned audit ledger ties every lease to a physical host, so clones need distinct hardware leases at full price. Marginal clone costs one lease plus 90-day lock, yielding zero revenue until unlock, making each extra identity strictly negative-EV.
